name: generate
title: Generate
description: UUIDs, ULIDs, Nano IDs, passwords and passphrases with their strength, random numbers and bytes, hashes and encodings of typed or copied text, lorem ipsum, a random colour, a QR code, a JWT taken apart. Every value copies on Enter.
author: pal

store.tagline: UUIDs, passwords, hashes, base64, lorem, QR codes and JWTs
features: The empty query lists a fresh value of everything: UUID v4 and v7, ULID, Nano ID, a password and a passphrase with their strength, a random number, hex and base64 bytes, a lorem ipsum paragraph, a random colour
A mode word narrows and parameterises: `password 32 alnum`, `passphrase 7`, `number 1-6`, `hex 32`, `lorem 3 paragraphs`, `colour`

Transforms work on the text typed after the mode, or on the newest clipboard text when nothing follows: `sha256`, `md5`, `sha1`, `sha512`, `hash` for all four, `base64`, `url`, `hex`, `encode`, `decode`
`qr <text>` draws the QR code (a small pure-TypeScript encoder, versions 1 to 40): the row shows it, Enter shows it large, `cmd+c` copies the SVG
`jwt <token>` takes a token apart: header, payload, expiry as relative time; the signature is never verified and the palette says so
Enter copies, `cmd+enter` pastes into the app in front, `cmd+shift+c` copies a whole group (all hashes, all encodings, header and payload); `cmd+r` lists again with fresh values
